theOneThingToReadFirst.why: This lane has no usable outbound egress; the assignment records that the proxy answers 403 CONNECT for state judiciary hosts and forbids fetching. Reachability and the SHA-256 remain the hosted runner's to settle.

INDIANA_SHARED_FINDING.theQuestionForTheOwner: Is an exact-host entry for www.indianalegalhelp.org wanted? It is the first-party publisher of the statewide self-service forms that the Indiana judiciary's own self-service page points at, so it is not a reseller; but it is an .org, and the policy's whole shape is that a non-government name is admitted one hostname at a time and only with a required expectedSha256, as ilcourtsaudio.blob.core.windows.net is. This lane does not propose the exception; it names the question.

notEstablished.note: Counted as eight distinct DOCUMENTS across nine label-instances: Form 281, Form 281E, the current HCJDC 159(b) edition (one document, two families), CR310, CR143, CR370, FI-05, GN10.
notEstablished.theCommonShape: Delaware and Missouri fail for the same structural reason and it is worth naming once: both publishers serve every document from an opaque numeric endpoint -- courts.delaware.gov/forms/download.aspx?id=NNNNN and www.courts.mo.gov/file.jsp?id=NNNNNN -- with no form number anywhere in the address. For these two states an address cannot be reasoned to; it can only be READ, either off a landing page or off a capture of one. Neither state prints its own address on its own forms, so the only route left is a capture, and the captures that would settle both live in private/Nationwide Record Clearing, which is not mounted here.

This page is corroborated three ways in committed evidence: data/rcap-all50/terminalization-treatments/mo.json ('Forms CR360, CR370, FI-05 and GN10 are published by the Office of the State Courts Administrator at https://www.courts.mo.gov/page.jsp?id=191585', repeated across tracks), data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/MO.memo.json, and data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json officialSourcePage for FI-05.
missouriSharedFinding.whyNoExactAddressExistsForAnyOfThem: courts.mo.gov serves documents from an opaque endpoint, https://www.courts.mo.gov/file.jsp?id=NNNNNN, with no form number anywhere in the address -- structurally the same problem as Delaware's download.aspx. Exactly ONE such id appears anywhere in this repository: https://www.courts.mo.gov/file.jsp?id=116396, recorded in SOURCE_BACKLOG_CLASSIFICATION.json for CR301 with its own identityConfidence reading 'inferred_requires_one_byte_check'. One unverified id is not a mapping. FABLE-COMP1's Louisiana precedent required 6/6 agreement against ids printed in mounted PDFs before its mapping was trusted; Missouri offers 1, and that one is self-declared as unverified. No id is extrapolated here.
missouriSharedFinding.facesRead: Every held Missouri form was opened and its footer read. CR375: 'SJRC (10-24) CR375 ... Mo. Const. art. XIV, s 2'. CR360: 'SJRC (10-24) CR360 ... 610.140, RSMo'. contradictionsWithTheRepository.what: SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json says HCJDC-159B has no printed title and no issuing body recorded 'in any committed record'. HI.memo.json records both.

HI.memo.json records the title 'Expungement Application', the issuer 'Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center of the State of Hawaii Department of the Attorney General', the printed revision, and the measured structural class (flat PDF, no /AcroForm, zero fields).

contradictionsWithTheRepository.consequence: A recorded Missouri build blocker is already retired by bytes the Master Library holds. It still needs an address for currentness, but the 'Jackson County variant' objection does not apply to the held copy.
contradictionsWithTheRepository.severity: a blocker recorded as open that is partly closed
